definitions.title: PS4 thermal incident
definitions.description: The cultural attaché promised GTA 6 would run. The console now needs a cooling break.

definitions.title: Roomba requests clearance
definitions.description: A floor robot has carried the visitor sign-in sheet under a cabinet.

definitions.title: Coffee machine boots to terminal
definitions.description: The espresso dispenser now demands an Arch Linux login before serving coffee.

definitions.title: Ambassador misses roll call
definitions.description: The ambassador is inside the sauna and the door handle is outside.

definitions.title: Boiler sings the anthem
definitions.description: The boiler announces each pressure change with a note of the national anthem.

definitions.title: A form for missing forms
definitions.description: The official request for duplicate paperwork disappeared inside its own folder.

definitions.title: Finland missing from country list
definitions.description: The welcome kiosk has rejected the entire delegation's country of origin.

definitions.title: Flags at crossed purposes
definitions.description: A seating chart and the flags on the table put the delegates in different countries.

definitions.title: Wednesday arrives twice
definitions.description: Two wall calendars disagree so strongly that neither meeting can begin.

definitions.title: Spoon census overdue
definitions.description: The kitchen inventory lists one teaspoon as a visiting member of staff.

definitions.title: Steam sensor wants mittens
definitions.description: The sauna thermostat has booked its own winter clothing allowance.

definitions.title: Radiator on diplomatic leave
definitions.description: The radiator refuses to heat the building until someone stamps its maintenance card.
